messages:
deploy-bot: [START] Prod rollout initiated by jane.doe
Commit: 5e8f2c1 (jane.doe) - fix/rerank-batching
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/1452
Canary: 5% -> schedule ramp to 25% in 10m if healthy. Change window: 13:00-15:00 UTC.
jane.doe: Ack. monitoring dashboards on my side, I pushed release notes to the PR description.
amanda: Thanks — can you paste the short release notes here for ops? quick grep is hard during a roll.
deploy-bot: Release notes (short):
```
- Improve reranker batching to reduce GPU overhead (5e8f2c1) - @jane.doe
- Fix tokenization edge-case for long prompts (b3f9a77) - @sam.mueller
- Healthcheck retries for upstream embedding service (a1c2d33) - @amanda
```
Full changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/compare/v2026.03.19...v2026.03.20
sam.mueller: Noted. Will watch kv-cache hit rate and latency p50/p95 on prod-rerank.
ops-oncall: Watching from my end. Alerting set for p99 > 800ms and error-rate +5%.
[10m later]
deploy-bot: Canary update: 5% -> HEALTHY. Metrics: p95 +3%, error-rate +0.8%. Scheduling ramp to 25% now.
release_mgr: Hold on the ramp. Our internal SLO for rerank p95 is 600ms. Can anyone confirm absolute numbers not just deltas?
jane.doe: Pulling raw numbers: prod-rerank p95 580ms -> 600ms after canary. p99 spikes to 820ms for short bursts (seen twice). It might be KV cache warmup.
amanda: I see a burst correlated to a particular client region eu-west-1. Could be cold caches there.
release_mgr: Given p99 > 800ms twice, let's pause ramp and pin traffic. If performance doesn't stabilize within 15m, rollback to tag v2026.03.19. Ops, please execute the pin now.
ops-oncall: Running traffic pin to canary only, stopping the 25% ramp. Command: `redwood routing set-pin --env prod --tag 5e8f2c1 --weight 5%` (executed)
deploy-bot: [UPDATE] Traffic pin applied. Current distribution: 95% -> v2026.03.19 (stable), 5% -> 5e8f2c1. Monitoring continues.
[15m later]
ops-oncall: No improvement in p99, still occasional spikes. Recommend rollback.
release_mgr: Approving rollback. Rolling back to v2026.03.19. Command: `redwood deploy rollback --env prod --to-tag v2026.03.19 --confirm` — please run and monitor.
ops-oncall: Executing now.
[short logs]
ops-oncall: `deploy-bot` shows: Rolling back prod -> v2026.03.19 (tag)
Commit pinned: 0f4b7a9 (previous stable) - https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/commit/0f4b7a9
Rollback completed in ~2m.
deploy-bot: [FINISH] Rollback completed by ops-oncall. Environment: prod. Reverted to tag v2026.03.19 (0f4b7a9). Details: rollback initiated 1769991360, completed 1769991499.
jane.doe: Thanks team. I'll open a follow-up PR to add region-specific cache prewarming and a smaller canary next time.
sam.mueller: I'll add additional p99 tests to the CI performance suite.
amanda: Noting for release notes: un-deployed due to perf regression; will mark the PR as blocked until fixes merged.
release_mgr: Good coordination. Documenting postmortem in #postmortems and scheduling a quick sync tomorrow.
